tasks.label: configure-debug
tasks.command: cmd /c '"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && set' | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') { Set-Item "env:$($matches[1])" $matches[2] } }; cmake -B Builds -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

tasks.label: build-debug
tasks.command: cmd /c '"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && set' | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') { Set-Item "env:$($matches[1])" $matches[2] } }; cmake --build Builds
